concept.label: Implemented here
concept.explain: A concept the workbench code defines; its location is in the glossary.

elsewhere.label: Implemented elsewhere
elsewhere.explain: Runs in a producer repository, not here.

theory.label: Method only
theory.explain: A mixed-methods idea the docs name that no code computes and no current plan builds.

planned.label: Planned (Plan #8)
planned.explain: A concept Plan #8 builds; the slice that builds it is named in the glossary. Not computed yet.

nodes.label: Method engine (producer)
nodes.explain: A method repository (qualitative_coding, process_tracing) that runs its own method and owns its strict export schema.

nodes.label: Method export
nodes.explain: The synthetic mirror of producer export shapes used by the DEMO-C1 fixtures, not any producer's own schema. The real exports Plan #8 reads are separate concepts: Qualitative Coding's grounded-theory export and Process Tracing's pt_export_v2.

nodes.label: Workbench consumer view
nodes.explain: The workbench's permissive, compatible reading of a producer export; it fails on an unsupported major version.

nodes.label: Source segment
nodes.explain: An exact span of a source document that evidence points to.

nodes.label: Cross-method link
nodes.explain: A typed link between objects from two methods' exports.

nodes.label: Review packet
nodes.explain: What a reviewer reads: the assembled exports, links and claim limits for one demonstration.

nodes.label: Evidence anchor
nodes.explain: A pointer from a finding to the evidence and source it rests on, by id (evidence_id, source_id); it stores no text span. Anchoring a passage to an exact span of the frozen text is new work in Plan #8 slice S1.

nodes.label: Publication gate
nodes.explain: The investigation spine's gate on a Process Tracing return: status accepted or blocked, and a blocked gate withholds the public conclusion while any claim failed review. It does not record that a researcher reviewed the conclusion. PT's own pt_export_v2 gate is a separate field (pt_export).

nodes.label: Connected run receipt
nodes.explain: The record of one run across producers: inputs, attempts, where it stopped and the trace ids.

nodes.label: Independent challenge
nodes.explain: A second model's advisory challenge to one finding, with the excerpts it saw.

nodes.label: Method profile
nodes.explain: A method's description for question-first routing on the method dashboard.

nodes.label: Route plan
nodes.explain: The dashboard's suggested route from a study brief to method stages.

nodes.label: Method phase
nodes.explain: Level 1 of the accepted discovery format: a phase of a method.

nodes.label: Analytical move
nodes.explain: Level 2: an analytical move inside a phase.

nodes.label: Execution action
nodes.explain: Level 3: an executable action a move is carried out by.

nodes.label: Method decomposition
nodes.explain: One of the 14 frozen Phase 3 records of a method's phases, moves and actions, checked by the validator.

nodes.label: STATO term
nodes.explain: A term of the pinned STATO 2026-04-20 release naming what a statistical step computes.

nodes.label: Collision group
nodes.explain: Steps from different methods grouped by canonical signature, verb, type pair or shared STATO term.

nodes.label: Capability verdict
nodes.explain: The section-10 verdict on a collision group: same_capability, shared_shell or different_capability, with its justification.

nodes.label: Guarded decision
nodes.explain: A decision request checked against bound artifacts, evidence and policy before it returns an outcome.

nodes.label: Quantitative audit
nodes.explain: The NYC bounded quantitative comparison: frozen query, drift replay and predicted-versus-observed audit.

nodes.label: Meta-inference
nodes.explain: A bounded conclusion drawn by intentionally joining qualitative and quantitative strands.

nodes.label: Public review artifact
nodes.explain: The investigation-spine payload and page that scripts/build_psychosisbank_public_review.py copies into deploy/ and the Cloudflare Worker serves.

nodes.label: Study corpus
nodes.explain: A set of source documents frozen for one study: each file's hash checked against its published source, with its licence, consent and retrieval date.

nodes.label: Qualitative strand
nodes.explain: A producer's qualitative result (QC's grounded-theory categories and propositions) read into the study, every claim tied to its passages.

nodes.label: Measurement instrument
nodes.explain: A qualitative category turned into a rule applied to every passage, with included and excluded examples, so it can be counted and checked against human coding.

nodes.label: Joint display
nodes.explain: One row per proposition placing the qualitative claim beside the measured numbers, with a convergence, complementarity, divergence or silence verdict.

nodes.label: Study definition
nodes.explain: One file per study naming its source record, file pattern, the authors' coding columns and the producer export paths; adding a study adds this file and frozen data, never code. Plan #8 S1.

nodes.label: Qualitative Coding theory export
nodes.explain: Qualitative Coding's grounded-theory result (schema major 3: categories, propositions, the segment ids each rests on) with its segment records, pinned by commit and sha256. Read in Plan #8 S1.

nodes.label: Authors' reference coding
nodes.explain: The corpus authors' own published coding (here 837 passages under 39 codes exported from OpenQDA), located in the frozen text by their words and used as the human reference for every strand. Plan #8 S1.

nodes.label: Measured result
nodes.explain: One measure's labels per unit, its per-class agreement and prevalence error on named held-out interviews, its interval by interview and its controls. Plan #8 S2.

nodes.label: Process Tracing export (pt_export_v2)
nodes.explain: Process Tracing's versioned export, read here by ProcessTracingExport; its own publication_gate.publishable field is read from Plan #8 S4.

nodes.label: Investigation record
nodes.explain: One study's question, evidence, method runs, findings, unresolved questions, reviews and next actions kept together (the evidence-to-action map's investigation spine), general over studies. Plan #8 S5; today only the PsychosisBank investigation, hard-coded.

nodes.label: Review decision
nodes.explain: A person's accept, reject or annotation of one meta-inference, saved with time and reviewer, appended to the review log. Plan #8 S5.

nodes.label: Research bundle
nodes.explain: One download of a study: corpus manifest, strand exports, joint display, review decisions, reflexivity memo, traces and a reporting checklist, each listed with its hash. Plan #8 S5.

nodes.label: Planted failure
nodes.explain: A deliberate fault (an altered quote, a wrong-interview passage, a swapped label, a fabricated id) the checks must catch. Plan #8 S1 and S6.

nodes.label: Benchmark
nodes.explain: The page comparing both corpora: each strand's agreement with the authors' coding, every planted failure and whether it was caught, cost and time per run, and the files each corpus's addition changed. Plan #8 S6.
